_doc: Per-car audit of the Mercedes CLEAN set (82 triaged clean, 2 exact duplicates dropped). Rubric: CLAUDE.md 'Per-car audit rubric'. Written incrementally -- the container is ephemeral and the /tmp Mercedes scratch was already lost once; only the repo copy survived.

dedd8f64a05d4d769d352ddcac034d25.name: Mercedes-Benz C-Class MK3 W204 2007-2014
dedd8f64a05d4d769d352ddcac034d25.note: tyres missing -- bare black hubs in the arches; stray white geometry floating above the roof in every view; and the RECOLOUR DID NOT LAND, body renders red under --colour silver. cov=0.061

63c20a79bbb84d60a466b578561f29a1.name: Mercedes-Benz ML (W163) 1997-2005
63c20a79bbb84d60a466b578561f29a1.note: ON ITS SIDE -- the front views show the undercarriage. geom_audit lists 'on-side' among the cases it detects, and it is still not wired into gpu_wave. Recolour also did not land. cov=0.061

a73c924778de4d66ae45a7880ab8943e.name: Mercedes Benz SLR McLaren (Bull)
a73c924778de4d66ae45a7880ab8943e.note: geometry reads as SLR McLaren -- chrome multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent across views, shut lines defined. But the RECOLOUR DID NOT LAND: renders its own black under forced silver. cov=0.077. Low-poly at 66k faces, and gloss black hides softness, so re-check if it is ever recoloured light. Ships single-neutral black

1480dab3f0c74dc0a262154ec508e7e0.note: out of scope AND no recolour -- Brabus aftermarket widebody with Brabus badging, not the stock G-Class a reg decodes to. Renders white under forced silver. cov=0.082

55df50faff8e4918b47a00c6e013d37b.note: wheels sunk inside the body -- the arches show only small dark cylinders and the van sits on the floor with no visible tyres. Recolour also did not land, renders white. cov=0.099

6df2a99b1dbc4b5b8baaf7accf18390f.name: 2012 Mercedes Benz Gl350
6df2a99b1dbc4b5b8baaf7accf18390f.note: GL350; multi-spoke wheels consistent, grille crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. BUT renders pure white at cov=0.114, so the respray likely did not land -- the low-coverage band is a gradient, not a cliff at 0.10

092ee873e85843c8826fc649c44e9a19.note: GLA35 AMG; black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent in all four views, Panamericana grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. 6ccc813d26ac4dcabdba83c896f4436c.name: Mercedes-Benz B-Klasse MK2 (W246) 2011-2018
6ccc813d26ac4dcabdba83c896f4436c.note: tyres missing -- bare brake discs and suspension exposed, wheels render as flat white plates protruding from the arches. Panel ripple along both flanks. Roof box (taxi sign or sensor) also present

_coverage_finding: TESTED AND CONFIRMED: all 5 entries in the Mercedes clean set with body-material coverage under 0.10 failed to recolour -- every one rendered its own colour under --colour silver (red, white, black, white, white). Coverage under ~10% means the classifier latched onto trim or a badge, not the body paint. 'clean' only requires mats>=1, so these passed triage. Low cov is a PREDICTOR of recolour failure (the GL350 at cov=0.114 also renders white, so the band is a gradient, not a cliff at 0.10) and should gate the colour bake, not just the eye. 5/5 in this set; consistent with Toyota #41 (pink) and #62 (black), which were also split/low-coverage.
